Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier of a security, assigned under a formal or proprietary identification scheme.

Name.name: Name
Name.definition: Name of the financial instrument in free format text.

ShortName.name: Short Name
ShortName.definition: Financial Instrument Short Name (FISN) expressed in conformance with the ISO 18774 standard.

IdentificationGuideline.definition: When an ISIN code exists, it is strongly recommended that the ISIN be used.
